name: @pipeworx/mcp-dadjokes

tools.name: random_joke
tools.description: Fetch one random dad joke from icanhazdadjoke.com. Returns joke text and alphanumeric ID.

tools.name: search_jokes
tools.description: Search dad jokes by keyword or topic. Returns matching jokes with IDs and text.

query.description: Term to search for within dad jokes.

limit.description: Maximum number of jokes to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_joke
tools.description: Retrieve a specific dad joke by ID. Returns the full joke text.

id.description: The ID of the dad joke to retrieve.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dadjokes forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dadjokes pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
